rows.note: Use this colloquial noun for the usual daytime or afternoon nap.

example.english: I want to take a nap after eating.
example.jyutping: ngo5 sik6 jyun4 faan6 soeng2 fan3 go3 aan3 gaau3

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a short sleep when the afternoon-nap context is not intended.

example.english: A short nap on a long bus ride can ease fatigue.
example.traditional: 搭長途車時小睡片刻，可以減輕疲勞。
example.jyutping: daap3 coeng4 tou4 ce1 si4 siu2 seoi6 pin3 hak1 ho2 ji5 gaam2 hing1 pei4 lou4
